svg.text: WF-012 64-bit timing writes: successful write events complete staged pairs; field-specific activation

Writes arrive high-then-low for PERIOD and low-then-high for COMPARE; same-value writes still pulse o_reg_wr_en and count. PERIOD/COMPARE activate only at update_event. TIMEOUT activates at the next interval start. The pulse already active retains width 5; the accepted trigger at cycle 22 latches width 9 for the next pulse.
